name: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries
description_short: Free online learner's dictionary with definitions, example sentences, audio pronunciation (British and American), and word-origin notes, plus grammar reference and topic word lists.
creator: Oxford University Press
internal_notes: Verified via search (direct fetch returned 403, bot-blocked, not down — site is live and widely referenced as of Sept 2026). Full A-Z dictionary content, grammar reference, and topic word lists are free with no login. cost set to freemium rather than free because OALD Premium (iWriter/iSpeaker) is a genuine paid tier layered on top — core lookup use is free but the site does sell a premium product, so 'free' would overstate it.
